WORLD BLOOD DONORS DAY 
Name of Activity : World Blood Donors Day. 
Need of the Activity: To overcome the deaths caused by scarcity of blood and Appreciation of 
the institutions for their support. 
NSS Unit of S.V.COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING has participated in World Blood Donor Day Program 
Conducted by Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, Department of Blood Transfu sion medicine, 
Tirupati on 14-06-2022 on the behalf of Institution, NSS Programme officer has attende d for the program and 
received a certificate of Appreciation from Dr B Vengamma, Director of SVIMS , Tirupati. The Convener of the 
program and SVIMS Blood Bank in charge Dr. S Sreedhar Babu have addressed the gathering about benefits of 
blood donation and the diseases transmitted through blood etc. The theme of thi s year is- “Donating blood is an 
act of solidarity, Join the effort and save the lives” Several participants were expressed their views and opinions 
in this regard.

INDEPENDENCE WEEK CELEBRATIONS 
Name of Activity : Independence Week Celebrations 
Need of the Activity: To enhance the worship and respect to the freedom fighters and nation. 
 
S V College of Engineering, NSS Unit has conducted the Independence week celebrations from 
8th to 15 th august, 2022 followed by Azadi Ka Amrit Mahostav -Har Ghar Tiranga at college 
campus and adopted village Venkatapuram. On this occasion rally was conducted with 200 meters 
national flag thereafter drawing & elocution competitions were conducted at college and a dopted 
village. A pledge was taken from all the students and faculty and distributed flags to households at 
Venkatapuram in the presence of Sarpanch Mrs. M Suseela & Village Revenue Officer Mr. T 
Purushotham. Best performers were awarded with prizes on 15 th august @ 76 th Independence day 
celebrations. A skit on Unity in diversity was also performed by volunteers to mark the occasion.

                                                   Seven Days NSS Special Camp,March,2023 
 
 
 
Special Camping forms an integral part of National Service Scheme. It has a special 
appeal to the youth as it provides unique opportunities to the students for group living, 
collective experience sharing and constant interaction with the community. 
 
The primary objectives of the special camping programs are: 
 
 
 Making education more relevant to the present situation, to meet the felt needs of the 
communities and supplement the education of university/college/school students by 
bringing them face to face with the prevailing situation of the community. 
 
  To provide opportunities for students to play their due roles in the implementation of 
various development programs by planning and executing development projects, which 
not only help in creating durable community assets in rural areas and slums but also  
result in the improvement of the condition of weaker sections of the communities. 
 
  Encouraging the students and non-student to work along with the adults in rural areas, 
thereby developing their character, social consciousness and commitment, discipline and 
healthy and helpful attitudes towards the community. 
 
 Building potential youth leaders by exploring the latent potential among the campers, 
both students as well as local youth (rural and urban), with a view to involve them more 
intimately in development projects for longer periods. The local leadership generated 
during the camps would also be useful in ensuring proper maintenance of the assets 
created as a result of the camps. 
 
  Emphasizing the dignity of labor and self-help and the need for combining physical work 
with intellectual pursuits, and encouraging youth to participate enthusiastically in the 
process of national development, and promote national integration through democratic 
living and cooperative action.

Day 2 – Plantation Program – 25, March 2023 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 On 25 th March, 2023, NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has 
successfully completed the event of Tree Plantation under the National Service Scheme at 
adopted village Venkatapuram. At that time Principal advice to volunteers to think 
differently for the Society to make positive changes and to make improvement.
 Programme Officer Dr T Chandraiah orients the NSS volunteers by notifying the 
importance of NSS for them as well as society. He shared his past experiences with 
volunteers that how he got the success through NSS and what difficulties he faced while 
performing his role as Programme Officer. He said that “In society all the human beings 
are comprise equal importance, no matter with the Men or Women. ” He also said that the 
dedication is must to accomplish the goals and dreams in life.
 Dr. S.Murali Krishna, Head, Dept. of IT also addressed the volunteers and passed a 
message of kindness & being helpful to the needy people. After the inspirational words of 
guests and Principal we all move towards the place where tree plantation took place. Total 
tree planted by all others including teachers, volunteers was more than 60 on the day. All 
were happy and experience proud after the tree plantation event was finished, because it

10|Page  
really feels great to do positive for the nature. 
 
Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal. 
 
 
 
 

11|Page  
Day 3 – Awareness rally on Corona virus & Distribution of water bowls 
  26, March 2023  
 
 The students, staff and local community people were sensitized about the spread of 
Corona Virus and its prevention. Pamphlets were distributed and posters were displayed in 
and around the village.
 This is an evolving situation, and timely and accurate information is critical. Educated 
students and villagers about positive preventive measures, talking to them about their 
fears, and giving them a sense of some control over risk of infection helped in reducing 
their anxiety.
 NSS Unit in association with NGO - Seva Natureals has distributed nearly 60 water bowls 
to quench the thirst of voiceless. This initiative strives to provide clean drinking water for 
animals and birds throughout the year.
 Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal.
 

12|Page  
 
 
 As a part of Special camp the National Service Scheme (NSS) in collaboration with 
Swachhta Action Plan (SAP) has organized a cleanliness drive on 27 March 2023 at 
adopted village Venkatapuram.
 The main objective of the cleanliness drive was to address the issues of hygiene, public 
sanitation conditions, and to create awareness towards cleanliness inside the village. The 
program has started at 10 am with an interactive session with the MPP school teachers, 
students and villagers regarding the need and importance of sanitation and cleanliness in 
life.
 Ingrained with the pure spirit of the Swachh Bharat, faculty members has motivated the 
volunteers to keep up the efforts of a clean environment on a personal level. After the 
interactive session, the cleanliness drive starts at 11 am with the help of more than 50 
volunteers of NSS. With the motto of “Swachh Bharat ”, all volunteers pick plastic and 
waste papers from the premises and dump them in the garbage bags.
Few photographs of the program are attached herewith for kind perusal 
Day 4 – Shramadhan - 27, March 2023 
13|Page  

14|Page  
 
 
 
 
 An Eye Camp was organized in association with VASAN Eye Care Hospital, Ti rupati in the 
school premises at Venkatapuram on Tuesday, 28 March 2023 to check the eyesight of the 
students and villagers belonging to the Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).
 Under the guidance of the Principal, Dr N.Sudhkar Reddy, the camp was conducted by the 
VASAN Eye Care Hospital, Tirupati. The objective of the camp was to check the eyesight 
of the students and provide eye drops and suggest spectacles, which are environmentally 
friendly and fully biodegradable, to those who were found to have weak eyesight.
 The camp started at 10:30 AM and lasted till 4:00 PM for all the teachers, students and 
villagers. The eyesight of 40 students and nearly 62 villagers were tested in the presence 
of an ophthalmologist and optometrist. The parents of the students of Classes I-V were 
also present in the school while the tests were conducted.
 The eye tests were conducted in three stages and the students who were found to have 
weak eyesight were prescribed perfectly fitting spectacles with lenses as per their required 
powers. Moreover, each student was counseled by Dr S Masthan along with the parents 
regarding their eyesight and they were also advised about the importance of wearing 
spectacles on a regular basis to protect their precious eyes.
 The event was a fruitful one as many students benefited from the eye check-up and the 
timely intervention of the school helped them to focus on their studies in a better manner.
Day 5 – Free Eye Camp - 28, March 2023 
15|Page  
The event not only helped to prevent the further deterioration of the eyesight of the 
students but also provided a sense of relief to the parents. 
 Few photographs of the camp are attached herewith for your kind perusal. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

16|Page  
 
 
 
 On 29th March 2023, NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering has organized 
Sports & games event at MPP School of adopted village Venkatapurm. The day was filled 
with a lot of excitement, along with thrills, spirit, and cheers. All the students were very 
excited about the day, and the activities that were going to be carried out throughout the 
day.
 
 There were many sports events that were carried out paralleled, which included Musical 
chairs, running race. Also, for children from classes 1 to 4, different games like sack race, 
and lemon spoon race were organized.
 
 All the students were awarded points on the basis of their performance and some other 
parameters. All were happy at the end of the event, and all the efforts of the students paid 
off. In the prize distribution ceremony (Valedictory), all the winning students and teams 
were awarded Geometry box, crayons and water bottles. In the end, the Headmaster of the 
school addressed all the students and their parents, congratulating all the winning students, 
and appreciating the efforts taken by each student on the day.
 
 Few photographs are attached herewith for your kind perusal.
Day 6 – Sports & Games - 29, March 2023

Day 7 – Valedictory - 31, March 2023 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 After the lunch on 31 st March 2023, the school ground was set and the furniture was 
arranged for the formal valedictory function. Refreshments were served at 4 PM. The 
formal function began at 2.30 PM with a prayer followed by a cake cutting. The program 
was presided by Shri Seshadri garu, Headmaster, MPP School, Venkatapurm.
 The program began with a lecture by NSS PO showcasing all the activities conducted 
during the camp and also delivered the concluding remarks about the NSS Camp. He 
congratulated and appreciated the work done by the volunteers of Sri Venkateswara 
College of Engineering. He also thanked Principal Dr N Sudhakar Reddy and Sarpanch 
Mrs. Sumathi for providing good facilities for the safe accommodation of the NSS 
volunteers.
 School staff congratulated all the NSS volunteers and appreciated all the work done by 
them in High School and surrounding area. Few NSS volunteers shared their experiences 
during the camp. This was followed by a Prize Distribution Ceremony for the winners of 
the competitions namely Musical chairs, kho-kho, in & out, sack race and lemon spoon 
etc.
